purpose: Test one frozen short-horizon consistency veto before viewing its outcomes; never promote an unvalidated model
universe: Current active Shanghai symbols sorted SHA256(symbol), positions [480:840]; excludes earlier first-120/240 audits; current-universe survivorship remains
signal_dates: Benchmark sessions from 2025-06-02 through 2026-09-30 with both D1/D2 no later than 2026-09-30, every tenth session starting the first; no October feedback outcomes
baseline: Same existing anti-chase, price-integrity and minimum-history exclusions; descending risk-aware-observation-v2 technical score, ATR then symbol ties
candidate: Identical baseline pool and ranking, plus current ridge-cycle-v3 two-session point estimate strictly above existing 0.30 percentage-point roundtrip stress, close >= MA5, five-session return > 0 and five-session stock-minus-index return >= 0; all evidence prefix-only and benchmark-aligned
model_use: Negative/missing or incoherent evidence only vetoes an observation; a positive point estimate neither adds points nor grants model_validated/eligible/actionable
selection_boundary: Build each pool and freeze all ranked selections using signal-date-or-earlier evidence before reading any D1/D2 outcome values; never remove an originally selected stock because its later outcome is missing
unresolved_rule: Keep any selected slot with missing/invalid D1/D2 prices or zero trading volume as unresolved, not cash; retain its date and slot, withhold complete all-date return summaries and deny deployment support if any selected outcome is unresolved
weights: Production keeps existing 60/40 and financial evidence groups; financial weights and complete-pool priority are not changed by this isolated experiment
financial_reason: Historical point-in-time financial/news/status snapshots unavailable; no current records inserted into past dates. This is a price-component ablation, not a replay of the full published recommendation pipeline
outcome: D1 raw open to D2 raw close minus 0.30 percentage points; fixed top1 and five equal 20-percent slots, unfilled slots cash=0; empty dates remain in opportunity denominator
benchmarks: same-date Shanghai index D1 raw open to D2 raw close minus identical 0.30 stress
deployment_rule: Do not search thresholds or change coefficients after results. If candidate both mean and worst-decile return worsen versus baseline for either top1 or top5, leave this combination offline. Otherwise disclose all mean/tail/coverage tradeoffs; this consistency constraint is never evidence of validated profitability
limitations: price-only ablation lacks historical financial/news/status and sector data
raw price outcomes omit dividend cash and corporate-action total returns
no limit-board, fill or actual order model
not the actual published cohorts or future accuracy
